notes.title: The new Truck & Logistics Simulator is coming soon!
notes.content:
Are you tired of driving trucks “only”? You toy with the idea of starting your own logistics company and wish for more vehicles for loading/transporting/unloading in a simulation? Then this simulation game might be the right one for you!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/873840/Truck_and_Logistics_Simulator/

The upcoming TRUCK & LOGISTICS SIMULATOR ([i]Release: June 23, 2020[/i]) enables you to take control of the logistics chain right from the start, optionally in single or multiplayer mode. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28135608/887b590010be9ad116cda48d1d06df94b688a286.jpg[/img]

Start your own logistics company and use more than [b]20 different vehicles[/b] to master complex loading tasks and deliver the freight to your customers properly. You can choose your vehicle from trucks (semi/rigid), vans, platform trucks, pickups, cars & monster trucks.

[previewyoutube=9A1PI-GZgA4;full][/previewyoutube]

Play together! In the [b]multiplayer mode[/b] you can create convoys with your friends and carry out deliveries together.

Master your way from level to level and collect experiences and money. But beware, if you damage the cargo or disregard the traffic rules, you will receive penalty points. 

Make smart, economical decisions, word hard and lead your company to great success!

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The Truck and Logistics Simulator will be released as an Early Access Version on June 23, 2020 on STEAM. The price will be €19.95/$19.99. 

Add to your wish list now and get notified about the release automatically!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/873840/Truck_and_Logistics_Simulator/

notes.title: Rescue HQ - Update 3 Out Now!

notes.title: Dealing with fires, mafia bosses, and toilet emergencies in Rescue HQ
notes.content:
There are plenty of TV shows about cops. Same with firefighters. And doctors! But if you ever wanted all of that drama under the same roof, and for that roof to be completely invisible so you can see into the building, then Rescue HQ—The Tycoon might be for you. It's a simulation game where you take charge of a fire department, a police department, and emergency medical staff, cram them all into one building, send them out to deal with unseen emergencies, and then suddenly realize all 30 of your rescue workers are sharing a single toilet because you're a terrible, terrible tycoon.

I began by building a small fire department. You need a locker room, which I initially assumed was akin to a break room or kitchen—just a requirement to have in place so your crew has something to do besides work. So, I placed my lockers out of the way in the back of the building. It turns out that before responding to an emergency every crew member has to run to their locker first to gear up. Thus, my crew is pretty slow to respond to emergencies because they basically have to run an entire lap around the building before they can hop in their vehicles. Off to a great start!

I built little offices to act as a place where new recruits could be hired, a training room so they can get whipped into shape, and garages for the various rescue vehicles to be dispatched from. As you successfully respond to emergencies and your reputation increases, you can use your reputation points to unlock new vehicles. Starting with just a police car, for instance, you can unlock a police van, pursuit vehicles, and a SWAT truck.

Pretty much everything gets upgraded in the same fashion: firefighting equipment, medical gear, and weapons for the cops. You can even unlock police dogs, which I did as soon as I could. I know my police department really needed riot gear, but I bought them a dog instead. I cannot be expected to make anything a higher priority than a dog.

You can't pet the dog, by the way. Someone let that dog-petting Twitter account know, please.

When an emergency arrives, you click on the notification and then put together your response team. Each emergency will specify the requirements: say, eight firefighters, a certain type of firetruck, maybe some equipment like air tanks or breaching gear. If you meet the requirements you can detail those resources and send your crew out knowing you've got a 100% success rate. If you don't meet the requirements, like maybe you've only got trainees available at the time or you haven't acquired the correct gear yet, your chances of success are lower, which means you won't make gains with your reputation, and it'll take longer to improve your departments.

Unfortunately, you don't get to see your brave teams actually deal with these emergencies. When they jump into their -cars or ambulances or firetrucks, they just speed out of the garage and disappear. Only when they return do you find out if they succeeded or failed. It's a bummer that you can't watch your tiny firemen battling a blaze or see your wee little cops busting itty bitty little perps, but it can still be a bit exciting when a bunch of emergencies happen at once, or when an emergency requires multiple teams. A car accident might need both fire and medical. A riot might need police and medical. At one point a self-driving car became self-aware and terrorized the city, and I needed to dispatch all three of my departments at once.

There are also major events you can plan in advance for. A mafia boss is scheduled to testify in court a week from now, and I'll need to provide police protection with eight fully trained officers, SWAT gear, and a van. A major soccer match is happening a few weeks later, and I need to prepare for the inevitable riots (again, I spend my points on the dog instead of riot gear, so I assume I'm already screwed). 

And naturally, you need to manage the moods of your little rescue workers, which I so far have not done a great job at. They're always tired because I haven't built enough places for them to rest. I can't hire more help because I'll need to install lockers for each of them, and I'll have to place those lockers even further from the front door than the existing lockers already are because there's no room anywhere else. The game actually had to tell me I had a toilet emergency—yes, it really used the words 'toilet emergency'—because I only had a single bathroom stall. I also only had a single refrigerator in the kitchen, meaning everyone was both incredibly hungry and had to poop at the same time. Nothing like sending people out to respond to emergencies when they're half-asleep, starving, and in need of a poo.

Rescue HQ - The Tycoon is a fun and hectic little sim that I might actually succeed at if I get around to adding more lockers and building what by now needs to be a simply enormous bathroom. Like I said, I wish I could actually watch my little crews doing their work in the field, but it's still enjoyable watching them run around and jump into their vehicles, working out in the training room, or bringing crooks back to sit in the holding cell. The price could be a stumbling point for some—it's $30 on Steam, although it's 10% off until next week.

notes.title: New Models | New Mechanics | Playtest end of the week
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34124484/b35f01b1fc0673a30dfb7713fbc4e5e3584752b1.png[/img]
We had some great progress we want to share with you!

We had a small interview with our tech artist Daniel who explain more about how the UI actually became what it is now and will let you take a small dive into our “BROWNOCALYPSE”. Please share your thoughts about our UI with us here or on Discord. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fH2B7lhicuY
Let's check some more of our new elements in the game. We added so many new objects so we created a nice small screenshot for you with some of these new objects down below.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34124484/a76bb8e4e6bb8b3a5bf00b4bc26a3f6431fd3d44.jpg[/img]

Wait, how about some new vehicles…. We had nice fire trucks, medic vans and all kind of police cars, but how about something faster? Something that might not be stuck on the ground? Yes, we thought having helicopter for each department. That could be something really nice for your emergencies.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34124484/7c3edf1c8db3d01d80370da4db1c5dd6e77662db.jpg[/img]

We also added a few more mechanics to the game after our last play test that we want to talk with you about. First of all we added a new “rookie function”: your future employee starts as a rookie that will not add any % or benefit to your mission but you actually need to train them before you can use them. Rookie’s will gain XP in missions or on training objects before they actually become a real employee.

While hire new people will actually offer you a set of different XP/Level progress to select from (a tier 2 Hire Desk actually help you find better people for example). In our last playtest you could just hire unlimited people and solve problems that way, but now there is a cap on people that can be increased by buying new lockers and place them so each person actually has it own locker where he also need to move before a emergency (so place them smart is a big benefit).

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34124484/f74523c718521b0c75b1592fe49a06c7200029cd.jpg[/img]

We also added room benefits. With adding the corridor as a part of our “room build options”, we offer a way to let people travel faster inside of the HQ: people move faster in a corridor than moving in normal rooms.

Last for today we want to remind everyone that we are going to start our next closed playtest later this week, we still looking to add a few more people to our test group from active users in our Discord, so join and hit us up there to become part of the test group.

That’s it for today, we are happy to share the new progress with you guys and would love to welcome you in our [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/5TseF23]Discord[/url] or on [url=https://www.facebook.com/RescueHQTheTycoon/]Facebook[/url]!

notes.title: No more Denuvo?
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34124484/b9fe73b9cb191495300e437c51477e2db156a32a.png[/img]
Rescue HQ – The Tycoon will release [b]without Denuvo protection[/b], this is more or less the news for today, but let us add a few more words on why etc. below.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34124484/60b0ba018ff9ccd85b66f9c0b01395efb1c82859.jpg[/img]

The last weeks we gathered so much great feedback about our game, people that like the art, the gameplay mechanics and much more. That's why we focused more on what people don't like about our plans.

DRM, something not to much gameplay related but some of you feel really upset, in other words Denuvo.

As some of you already noticed we had the Denuvo disclaimer on the Steampage – yes it was planned to run our game DRM protected by Denuvo, but now it is gone.

Sure many of you guys won't understand why we wanted to put Denuvo into our game but let me clarify a few things.
[i][list][*][b]DRM is a pain, it limits me![/b]
DRM is something no one likes, most of you people never will hit any requirements that are set by the DRM Software – 5 PCs within 24h… when would this appear to you?
[*][b]DRM slows down the game![/b]
In our tests (as a publisher) and the test of the developing studio we actually didn't see a single impact on running the software with DRM or without.
[*][b]We'll have to pay more `caus of DRM![/b]
DRM is cheap – it is not free but with only one person more that actually would buy the game many DRM protections are paid
 - Day 1 cracks are really really awful
 - Visit the known pages and see your title, free, with one click with 100 of comments is a pain.
 - People join your Discord, email your support and actually eat your time etc. who have never paid a penny – they hurt.
 - People who are telling you, yes i just try it – i will buy it later (do you know anyone who ever did that?)[/list][/i]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34124484/4e3d393c71e60cac4e1ea94f2e7d62225a67f0e2.jpg[/img]
[b]Pirates be prepared![/b]

[i]Protecting your idea, your baby, your work for the last year, often feels like protecting your family (many of you game devs might understand), but the question is what's the right „weapon“ to protect them.[/i]

With being open in all communication around our small idea of „Rescue HQ – The Tycoon“ up to the development and hopefully after the release we try to focus on the community, on the ideas, thoughts, requests that you actually share with us.

That's why we ask ourselves, is it actually worth to hold YOU back from buy the game – because you don't like DRM, because we want to hold back Mr Torrent from getting the hands on our game? After many thoughts, talks etc. it is a clear NO for us. We don't want to hold you back, just because Mr Torrent would never ever buy the game. Thats why we removed the need of any kind of DRM Software protection and just hope that you love our art, our baby, our game that much that you are willing and fair enough to actually buy it.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34124484/807ca2e352f2f54842efc69c060a7dd86b1c0ec2.jpg[/img]

Getting rid of any kind of DRM actually even open us more options in modding, that's why we are super happy to announce that we actually will be open with most of script to the people who buy our game.[spoiler]So you can modify it up until making a Walking Dead Clone out of it where you actually need to gether survivors in your HQ and send them out to find new one.[/spoiler]

Please feel more then free to share your experience, your thoughts or just your words about going Denuvo free (more or less DRM free beside the needed Steam stuff).
